items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: O'Neill Old Needie Spencer was another good one.

ctx.x: Including symphony players? Does he play --

Yeah, including any of them. Symphony players, concert players, don't mention them. Throw them out of your mind. Buddy Rich, without a doubt, is the greatest snare drum player, to me, that ever lived. And he taught himself. Every time a man get those single strokes down, it's easy to do Mama-Daddy. That's double strokes. But single strokes, to me, is the foundation of all good drummers. All good drummers.
So, I can call the names and all, but thinking of them offhand is pretty hard for me. O'Neill Old Needie Spencer was another good one.
